panels.title: Ingest rate: target vs accepted (lines/s, client-side)
panels.description: Per system: the writer's target rate (flat in a fixed-rate run, a rising staircase in a ramp run), the rate the generator ACTUALLY produced (generated - if it sags below target, the harness, not the systems, is the bottleneck), and the rate each system accepted. Where accepted stops following target, that system has hit its ingest ceiling.

panels.title: Lines sent vs stored per system
panels.description: Sent = lines the writer delivered (got 2xx), client-side. Stored = rows actually retained, counted server-side by the querier's stats loop (logbench_stored_rows). The gap is data lost after ack - a system that acknowledges writes then drops rows shows sent > stored here. A system with no exact server-side count (e.g. Loki returns none) has no stored series and shows only sent.

panels.title: Ingest rate: target vs stored (lines/s, server-side)
panels.description: Per system: the writer's target rate, the rate the generator actually produced (generated - if it sags below target, the plateau is the harness's ceiling, not the system's), and the achieved ingest rate measured server-side (the slope of stored rows, clamped at zero). A system that reports no exact stored count (e.g. Loki) falls back to the client-side accepted rate.

panels.title: Container restarts per system (cumulative)

targets.expr: sum by (label_logs_benchmark_victoriametrics_com_system) (kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total{namespace=~"logs-bench.*", namespace!="logs-bench-monitoring"} * on(namespace,pod) group_left(label_logs_benchmark_victoriametrics_com_system) (group by (namespace,pod,label_logs_benchmark_victoriametrics_com_system) (kube_pod_labels{namespace=~"logs-bench.*", namespace!="logs-bench-monitoring", label_logs_benchmark_victoriametrics_com_system!=""}) or on(namespace,pod) label_replace(group by (namespace,pod,logs_benchmark_victoriametrics_com_system) (group by (namespace,pod,node) (kube_pod_info{namespace=~"logs-bench.*", namespace!="logs-bench-monitoring"}) * on(node) group_left(logs_benchmark_victoriametrics_com_system) group by (node,logs_benchmark_victoriametrics_com_system) (machine_cpu_cores{logs_benchmark_victoriametrics_com_system!=""})), "label_logs_benchmark_victoriametrics_com_system", "$1", "logs_benchmark_victoriametrics_com_system", "(.+)")))

panels.description: Cumulative container restarts per system, from kube-state-metrics counted for the pod's logs-benchmark.victoriametrics.com/system label, or its node's label for a pod without one. Each step up marks a container death (crash or OOM) and restart; a flat zero line means the system stayed up all run. Counts every cause on purpose: an OOM-only count would miss non-memory crashes (a collector exiting with reason Error), and the cAdvisor OOM counter is unreliable here (it resets per container instance). Read the actual cause (OOMKilled vs Error) from the pod's last-terminated reason when a step appears.

panels.title: Dropped lines per system (per second)
panels.description: Lines the writer dropped because this system's channel was full (dropOnFull=true, ingest-ceiling runs): drop rate ~ target minus what the system absorbs, so a nonzero line here CONFIRMS the plateau on the stored-rate panel is the system's ceiling. Always zero in blocking (query) runs and while every system keeps up.

panels.title: Fetch newest 100 error logs (5m window), p99
panels.description: logsql: level:=error | sort by (_time) desc | limit 100

panels.title: Count errors per app (1h window), p99
panels.description: logsql: level:=error | stats by (app) count() hits

panels.title: Count one app's errors (1h window), p99
panels.description: logsql: {app="..."} level:=error | stats count() hits

panels.title: Find a token with zero hits (24h window), p99
panels.description: logsql: "7f3c9a2e-bench-needle" | limit 10

panels.title: Search a common word (1h window), p99
panels.description: logsql: "program" | sort by (_time) desc | limit 100

panels.title: Count logs per minute (1h window), p99
panels.description: logsql: * | stats by (_time:1m) count() hits

panels.title: Failed benchmark queries (per second)
panels.description: Benchmark queries that failed, timed out or returned an invalid response (not the systems' own log errors). These discard their latency sample, so spikes here matter even when latency looks flat. Per-query breakdown is in the querier logs.

panels.title: CPU by system (cores)

targets.expr: sum by (label_logs_benchmark_victoriametrics_com_system) (sum by (namespace,pod) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{namespace=~"logs-bench.*", namespace!="logs-bench-monitoring", container!="", metrics_path="/metrics/resource"}[$__rate_interval])) * on(namespace,pod) group_left(label_logs_benchmark_victoriametrics_com_system) (group by (namespace,pod,label_logs_benchmark_victoriametrics_com_system) (kube_pod_labels{namespace=~"logs-bench.*", namespace!="logs-bench-monitoring", label_logs_benchmark_victoriametrics_com_system!=""}) or on(namespace,pod) label_replace(group by (namespace,pod,logs_benchmark_victoriametrics_com_system) (group by (namespace,pod,node) (kube_pod_info{namespace=~"logs-bench.*", namespace!="logs-bench-monitoring"}) * on(node) group_left(logs_benchmark_victoriametrics_com_system) group by (node,logs_benchmark_victoriametrics_com_system) (machine_cpu_cores{logs_benchmark_victoriametrics_com_system!=""})), "label_logs_benchmark_victoriametrics_com_system", "$1", "logs_benchmark_victoriametrics_com_system", "(.+)")))

panels.description: Total CPU per system under test, summed over every pod with its logs-benchmark.victoriametrics.com/system label and every unlabeled pod on its node (SigNoz = clickhouse + zookeeper + collector + query; ClickStack = clickhouse + keeper + collector + mongo + hyperdx).

panels.title: Memory: anonymous per system

targets.expr: sum by (label_logs_benchmark_victoriametrics_com_system) (sum by (namespace,pod) (container_memory_rss{namespace=~"logs-bench.*", namespace!="logs-bench-monitoring", container="", image="", metrics_path="/metrics/cadvisor"}) * on(namespace,pod) group_left(label_logs_benchmark_victoriametrics_com_system) (group by (namespace,pod,label_logs_benchmark_victoriametrics_com_system) (kube_pod_labels{namespace=~"logs-bench.*", namespace!="logs-bench-monitoring", label_logs_benchmark_victoriametrics_com_system!=""}) or on(namespace,pod) label_replace(group by (namespace,pod,logs_benchmark_victoriametrics_com_system) (group by (namespace,pod,node) (kube_pod_info{namespace=~"logs-bench.*", namespace!="logs-bench-monitoring"}) * on(node) group_left(logs_benchmark_victoriametrics_com_system) group by (node,logs_benchmark_victoriametrics_com_system) (machine_cpu_cores{logs_benchmark_victoriametrics_com_system!=""})), "label_logs_benchmark_victoriametrics_com_system", "$1", "logs_benchmark_victoriametrics_com_system", "(.+)")))

panels.description: Anonymous (heap/stack) memory per system: cAdvisor container_memory_rss reads the cgroup memory.stat anon counter, so despite the name this is anonymous memory - the unreclaimable part. Page cache is excluded; compare with the RSS panel to see file-backed mappings.

panels.title: Disk used by system (bytes)

targets.expr: sum by (label_logs_benchmark_victoriametrics_com_system) (kubelet_volume_stats_used_bytes{namespace=~"logs-bench.*", namespace!="logs-bench-monitoring"} * on(namespace,persistentvolumeclaim) group_left(pod) kube_pod_spec_volumes_persistentvolumeclaims_info{namespace=~"logs-bench.*", namespace!="logs-bench-monitoring"} * on(namespace,pod) group_left(label_logs_benchmark_victoriametrics_com_system) (group by (namespace,pod,label_logs_benchmark_victoriametrics_com_system) (kube_pod_labels{namespace=~"logs-bench.*", namespace!="logs-bench-monitoring", label_logs_benchmark_victoriametrics_com_system!=""}) or on(namespace,pod) label_replace(group by (namespace,pod,logs_benchmark_victoriametrics_com_system) (group by (namespace,pod,node) (kube_pod_info{namespace=~"logs-bench.*", namespace!="logs-bench-monitoring"}) * on(node) group_left(logs_benchmark_victoriametrics_com_system) group by (node,logs_benchmark_victoriametrics_com_system) (machine_cpu_cores{logs_benchmark_victoriametrics_com_system!=""})), "label_logs_benchmark_victoriametrics_com_system", "$1", "logs_benchmark_victoriametrics_com_system", "(.+)")))

panels.description: Total disk used per system under test. Each PVC is attributed to a system by walking PVC -> owning pod -> the pod's logs-benchmark.victoriametrics.com/system label, or its node's label for a pod without one, so a system's PVCs (e.g. SigNoz's ClickHouse + Zookeeper + metadata DB) roll up automatically with no per-system config. Empty on kind (no CSI volume stats).

panels.title: Disk write by system (bytes/s)

targets.expr: sum by (label_logs_benchmark_victoriametrics_com_system) (sum by (namespace,pod) (rate(container_fs_writes_bytes_total{namespace=~"logs-bench.*", namespace!="logs-bench-monitoring"}[$__rate_interval])) * on(namespace,pod) group_left(label_logs_benchmark_victoriametrics_com_system) (group by (namespace,pod,label_logs_benchmark_victoriametrics_com_system) (kube_pod_labels{namespace=~"logs-bench.*", namespace!="logs-bench-monitoring", label_logs_benchmark_victoriametrics_com_system!=""}) or on(namespace,pod) label_replace(group by (namespace,pod,logs_benchmark_victoriametrics_com_system) (group by (namespace,pod,node) (kube_pod_info{namespace=~"logs-bench.*", namespace!="logs-bench-monitoring"}) * on(node) group_left(logs_benchmark_victoriametrics_com_system) group by (node,logs_benchmark_victoriametrics_com_system) (machine_cpu_cores{logs_benchmark_victoriametrics_com_system!=""})), "label_logs_benchmark_victoriametrics_com_system", "$1", "logs_benchmark_victoriametrics_com_system", "(.+)")))

panels.description: Write throughput of each system's data volume, from cadvisor container_fs summed over every pod with its logs-benchmark.victoriametrics.com/system label and every unlabeled pod on its node (matches the node data-disk rate).

panels.title: Disk read by system (bytes/s)

targets.expr: sum by (label_logs_benchmark_victoriametrics_com_system) (sum by (namespace,pod) (rate(container_fs_reads_bytes_total{namespace=~"logs-bench.*", namespace!="logs-bench-monitoring"}[$__rate_interval])) * on(namespace,pod) group_left(label_logs_benchmark_victoriametrics_com_system) (group by (namespace,pod,label_logs_benchmark_victoriametrics_com_system) (kube_pod_labels{namespace=~"logs-bench.*", namespace!="logs-bench-monitoring", label_logs_benchmark_victoriametrics_com_system!=""}) or on(namespace,pod) label_replace(group by (namespace,pod,logs_benchmark_victoriametrics_com_system) (group by (namespace,pod,node) (kube_pod_info{namespace=~"logs-bench.*", namespace!="logs-bench-monitoring"}) * on(node) group_left(logs_benchmark_victoriametrics_com_system) group by (node,logs_benchmark_victoriametrics_com_system) (machine_cpu_cores{logs_benchmark_victoriametrics_com_system!=""})), "label_logs_benchmark_victoriametrics_com_system", "$1", "logs_benchmark_victoriametrics_com_system", "(.+)")))

panels.description: Read throughput of each system's data volume, from cadvisor container_fs summed over every pod with its logs-benchmark.victoriametrics.com/system label and every unlabeled pod on its node (matches the node data-disk rate).

panels.title: Disk per million log lines (bytes)

targets.expr: sum by (label_logs_benchmark_victoriametrics_com_system) (kubelet_volume_stats_used_bytes{namespace=~"logs-bench.*", namespace!="logs-bench-monitoring"} * on(namespace,persistentvolumeclaim) group_left(pod) kube_pod_spec_volumes_persistentvolumeclaims_info{namespace=~"logs-bench.*", namespace!="logs-bench-monitoring"} * on(namespace,pod) group_left(label_logs_benchmark_victoriametrics_com_system) (group by (namespace,pod,label_logs_benchmark_victoriametrics_com_system) (kube_pod_labels{namespace=~"logs-bench.*", namespace!="logs-bench-monitoring", label_logs_benchmark_victoriametrics_com_system!=""}) or on(namespace,pod) label_replace(group by (namespace,pod,logs_benchmark_victoriametrics_com_system) (group by (namespace,pod,node) (kube_pod_info{namespace=~"logs-bench.*", namespace!="logs-bench-monitoring"}) * on(node) group_left(logs_benchmark_victoriametrics_com_system) group by (node,logs_benchmark_victoriametrics_com_system) (machine_cpu_cores{logs_benchmark_victoriametrics_com_system!=""})), "label_logs_benchmark_victoriametrics_com_system", "$1", "logs_benchmark_victoriametrics_com_system", "(.+)"))) / on(label_logs_benchmark_victoriametrics_com_system) (sum by (label_logs_benchmark_victoriametrics_com_system) (label_replace(logbench_stored_rows, "label_logs_benchmark_victoriametrics_com_system", "$1", "system", "(.+)")) or sum by (label_logs_benchmark_victoriametrics_com_system) (label_replace(logbench_lines_sent_total, "label_logs_benchmark_victoriametrics_com_system", "$1", "system", "(.+)"))) * 1e6

panels.description: On-disk volume bytes divided by stored lines, times one million: the storage cost of one million log lines. The divisor is the exact stored count where a system reports one, else its accepted (sent) count. Read it after a run, once disk use has settled. Volume bytes include the write-ahead log and indexes.

panels.title: Send queue length
panels.description: Records waiting in the per-system queue (0..buffer). Pinned at the cap = workers saturated, backpressure active.

panels.title: Send retries (per second)
panels.description: Requests retried after a 429, 502, 503 or 504 answer or a connection error. For Elasticsearch and OpenSearch, this also counts resending the bulk items rejected with 429. The system is overloaded but still protects itself.

panels.title: Send errors (lines/s)
panels.description: Lines lost to delivery failures after retries were exhausted, or that could not be encoded, per system. Channel-full drops (dropOnFull=true shedding load at the writer) are a different signal: see 'Dropped lines per system' in the Ingest row.

panels.title: SigNoz memory per pod (bytes)
panels.description: Per-pod working-set memory of the SigNoz components (ClickHouse, Zookeeper, otel-collector, query-service), to see which one is under memory pressure. The stack shares one node with no k8s limits; ClickHouse self-caps at a fraction of the node's RAM (max_server_memory_usage_to_ram_ratio).

panels.title: Memory by system

targets.expr: sum by (label_logs_benchmark_victoriametrics_com_system) (sum by (namespace,pod) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{namespace=~"logs-bench.*", namespace!="logs-bench-monitoring", container!="", metrics_path="/metrics/resource"}) * on(namespace,pod) group_left(label_logs_benchmark_victoriametrics_com_system) (group by (namespace,pod,label_logs_benchmark_victoriametrics_com_system) (kube_pod_labels{namespace=~"logs-bench.*", namespace!="logs-bench-monitoring", label_logs_benchmark_victoriametrics_com_system!=""}) or on(namespace,pod) label_replace(group by (namespace,pod,logs_benchmark_victoriametrics_com_system) (group by (namespace,pod,node) (kube_pod_info{namespace=~"logs-bench.*", namespace!="logs-bench-monitoring"}) * on(node) group_left(logs_benchmark_victoriametrics_com_system) group by (node,logs_benchmark_victoriametrics_com_system) (machine_cpu_cores{logs_benchmark_victoriametrics_com_system!=""})), "label_logs_benchmark_victoriametrics_com_system", "$1", "logs_benchmark_victoriametrics_com_system", "(.+)")))

panels.description: Total memory per system under test, summed over every pod with its logs-benchmark.victoriametrics.com/system label and every unlabeled pod on its node (SigNoz = clickhouse + zookeeper + collector + query; ClickStack = clickhouse + keeper + collector + mongo + hyperdx). Working set, so it includes active page cache: engines that rely on the page cache look bigger than their heap.

panels.title: Memory: RSS per system

targets.expr: sum by (label_logs_benchmark_victoriametrics_com_system) (sum by (namespace,pod) (container_memory_rss{namespace=~"logs-bench.*", namespace!="logs-bench-monitoring", container="", image="", metrics_path="/metrics/cadvisor"} + container_memory_mapped_file{namespace=~"logs-bench.*", namespace!="logs-bench-monitoring", container="", image="", metrics_path="/metrics/cadvisor"}) * on(namespace,pod) group_left(label_logs_benchmark_victoriametrics_com_system) (group by (namespace,pod,label_logs_benchmark_victoriametrics_com_system) (kube_pod_labels{namespace=~"logs-bench.*", namespace!="logs-bench-monitoring", label_logs_benchmark_victoriametrics_com_system!=""}) or on(namespace,pod) label_replace(group by (namespace,pod,logs_benchmark_victoriametrics_com_system) (group by (namespace,pod,node) (kube_pod_info{namespace=~"logs-bench.*", namespace!="logs-bench-monitoring"}) * on(node) group_left(logs_benchmark_victoriametrics_com_system) group by (node,logs_benchmark_victoriametrics_com_system) (machine_cpu_cores{logs_benchmark_victoriametrics_com_system!=""})), "label_logs_benchmark_victoriametrics_com_system", "$1", "logs_benchmark_victoriametrics_com_system", "(.+)")))

panels.description: Classic resident set size per system: anonymous plus file-backed pages currently mapped in RAM (container_memory_rss + container_memory_mapped_file, cAdvisor path). Excludes unmapped page cache.
